page.layout: One page of text, centred title block; a printer's device (woodcut emblem) at lower left below the text. No margin notes.
page.notes: The emblem at lower left is a printer's woodcut device, not transcribed. Words such as "Trium Clarisimarum" and "Hasce" are as printed; the long-s forms in "Clarisimarum", "Confulibus" and "Senatoribus" are rendered as plain s. "Trium Clarisimarum Ciuitatum" line is set in a slightly different size. The line "IN ACTA APOSTOLORVM" has a swash M at its end, read as M. Some letters are worn and uncertain, including "Heluetiorum" and "amplexarum".
